items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The music I did for Mr. Rico... I had to call three or four record companies to come to the screening.

ctx.x: The ones I’ve got are Cool and Groovy, The Sweet Smell of Success. No, neither one of those?

Okay, Dean Martin -- Mr. Rico. Mr. Rico, right. So we go out there and we go shopping, right. Hale’s with me and I see a shirt that I like, right, silk shirt. So I think I paid about $100 or something for it. Hale flipped. I said, Hale let me -- you know, now you think that was extravagant, yeah, you know. I said, well hell, you smoke $25 cigars. So what’s the difference? You pay $25 for a cigar; I pay $100 for a shirt.
Which one is going to last longer? One of the things when I look back at your career, I look at the fact that you’ve been -- as you’ve said, you know, you’ve been a pioneer and I actually talked -­
